answer: Every identity posts a bond, and a replayed submission claws the bond back instead of just rejecting the answer. Assume the attacker is smarter and will vary the wording: the hash of the work, not the text, is what gets compared, so a reworded copy of the same computation still replays. Example: 300 aliases resubmit one payload in 300 phrasings and lose 300 bonds at once. The pearl of a copied answer is not worth the tide of bond money it drags out of the meadow.
